name: How often should I perform routine property maintenance for my commercial property?

mainEntity.name: How often should I perform routine property maintenance for my commercial property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of routine property maintenance depends on the type of property, its age, and its usage. Generally, an annual inspection by a professional can identify potential issues before they become costly problems. HVAC systems often require seasonal checks, and exterior elements like roofing and landscaping may need quarterly or biannual attention. Developing a tailored maintenance schedule with a contractor can ensure your commercial property remains in optimal condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Routine property maintenance frequency varies, but annual professional inspections and seasonal checks for systems like HVAC are generally recommended. A tailored schedule is best.
